findings.text: review_read_pass() has no production caller: admit_once (reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:3127) enters readiness_pass() alone, so the per-pass plan-review store cache never activates, while the landed evidence fragment (docs/evidence/fragments/a-queue-holds-the-whole-plan/a-dispatch-reads-one-sections-readiness.html:6) and the manifest both state the store is cached for the length of an admission pass.

_plan_inventory_item rebuilds the roadmap inventory row rather than routing the plan through reckon/mcp_discovery.py:_inventory_row, the owner of that row shape on the whole-project path, and omits fields the owner supplies (resource_id, href, tags, last, workflow_status), so a field the roadmap later reads reaches the whole-project read and is absent on the bounded read; the equality arm cannot catch it because the fixture plans carry none of those fields.

the test whose name and docstring say a direct dispatch outside a pass builds its own now asserts it adds no build at all (len(builds) stays 1), so the name states the opposite of the assertion it guards.
